hook: This entry is told almost entirely in pictures: icons, arrows, stick figures and two short comic strips, with no ordinary prose at all. The format is not a gimmick; it is the containment procedure. Take it panel by panel and work out the rules yourself.
whyItMatters: It sits among the highest-rated pages on the site even though you can read it in under a minute. It shows that an SCP file can carry a full set of rules, a threat and two test logs through images alone. Even the title is part of the design: the groups of dots stand in for the item number without a single digit.
thingsToNotice: The diagrams lay out the rule: SCP-2521 is drawn to any information about itself that is written down, stored digitally or spoken aloud, while pictures, symbols and charts are safe. Pictogram files are restricted to level 4 and 5 staff, and a separate panel shows it standing outside a locked cell, so no physical containment holds it. In the first test a D-class writes about it and it takes the page, leaving him cowering on the floor. In the second he starts to speak about it, and it wraps him in its tendrils and carries him off, leaving an empty room. That difference is why the whole article, and any discussion of it, has to stay wordless.
